articleTitle: Why Reminding Your Teen About Grades Doesn't Work
imageHeadline: Nagging Your Teen About Grades? Research Says It Backfires
imageSubtext: What actually builds academic motivation in adolescents
pinTitle: Why Nagging Teens About Grades Backfires (& What Research Says Works Instead)
pinDescription: Bright kid but no motivation to study? The research on adolescent academic motivation shows why reminding and nagging undermines the very drive you're trying to build. Learn the evidence-based approaches that actually support teens' intrinsic motivation and academic engagement.
